title: Custom-Sized Boxes for Shipping: How to Calculate Size, Board and Cost
excerpt: Learn how to calculate custom shipping box dimensions, account for protective inserts and corrugated board thickness, estimate dimensional weight, and prepare a factory-ready box specification.
